environment.scope: Archived native Android instrumentation in one API35 x86_64 KVM emulator using synthetic debug fixtures; no physical-device performance claim.

quantile_definition: Nearest rank ceil(p*n)-1, zero based; n=30 p50=sorted[14], p95=sorted[28], max=sorted[29]. Not the average of the two central samples.

duration_definitions.saveMs: (saveEndNs-saveStartNs)/1e6; repository-call and watchdog boundaries, with Committed and final content/revision verified. Not pure SQL writer wait or commit duration.
duration_definitions.firstCallTime: (collectorEndNs-collectorStartNs)/1e6; includes root/stat scan, guard checks and cleanup; overlaps author save in all 60 trials.
duration_definitions.finishCallTime: (finishEndNs-finishStartNs)/1e6; a separate collect after save and first collect finish.
duration_definitions.firstPlusFinishCallTime: Sum of the two GC call intervals, excluding the inter-call gap; never add overlapping save duration.
duration_definitions.firstStartToFinishEndTime: (finishEndNs-collectorStartNs)/1e6; includes inter-call gap, excludes fixture creation, final verification and cleanup.
duration_definitions.rootScans: after-roots callback count, one root-enumeration pass per collect; not all SELECT statements or source-body reads. These natural fixtures contain zero explicit roots.

exposure_definition: saveStartNs <= before-batch-commit timestamp <= saveEndNs. Hook is inside the GC writer transaction after actual DELETE statements of a nonempty batch and before commit. Point-in-call coverage, not lock-wait measurement. No such hook occurred in any first collect of methods 56/57.

limits: Both groups are 0/30, below unchanged minimum 20. Exposed p50/p95/max remain null; all-save distributions are not actual-deletion-contention distributions.

All first calls scanned once, deleted zero and deferred; actual deletion of 1280 versions occurred only in each second call after save. Deferred means guard mismatch in this source path, but exact guard-vector deltas are not logged.
Methods 11/12 cover author requests queued behind actual DELETE work, commit/content and live-root safety under deterministic gates. Gate durations are not natural latency samples.

Each natural sample is a fresh 1281-source fixture and one rename. No high-root-cardinality, continuous writes, full-round concurrent deletion, fairness-under-sustained-writes or cross-version equivalence conclusion.
beforeRenameReceiptNs is inside the rename transaction, before its receipt; not transaction entry or physical commit timing.
Raw JUnit seconds and host/XML seconds describe whole-method windows, not per-save or deletion-only latency.
missing_evidence: At least 20 naturally exposed complete saves per connection mode under a prospectively frozen workload, retaining all outcomes.
Nonblocking writer transaction-entry and deletion batch/commit timing, or equivalent tracing, for a pure writer-queue/lock-hold claim.
Separately scoped common-source paired GC benchmark for a B-to-C1 GC or save regression conclusion.
minimal_next_step: Keep current production code, probes and thresholds unchanged; retain this run as functional PASS with INSUFFICIENT_EXPOSURE. Do not reclassify the all-save distribution as deletion blocking or pool prior45b samples.
Do not blindly repeat the same after-scan race to seek a passing exposure count. First freeze a separately named contention diagnostic if actual-delete latency is still required.

A minimal concrete future design would use one nonblocking notification immediately after a deletion batch guard succeeds and before its DELETE loop, launching the independent author from its coordinator. The current hooks do not expose that start boundary, so this needs separately reviewed instrumentation, not an interpretation change to existing records. The GC hook must never await, sleep, or prolong the writer transaction.

Retain the1281-source fixture,256 batch size,30 trials per connection,original5s watchdog,Committed/revision/content/retention checks and original exposure rule saveStart<=before-batch-commit<=saveEnd; preserve every sample and report INSUFFICIENT_EXPOSURE again if fewer than20 qualify. Name the event-triggered diagnostic separately because it changes request timing, not the current natural workload.

Do not require full-round deletion plus continuously committing authors: the intended conservative guard can defer the remaining stale candidate list after a commit. Deterministic gated safety tests prove protection; their artificial hold time is never a performance sample.

concurrency_guard_review.snapshot: Capture the writer guard before one private read snapshot; roots and ordered candidates are private TEMP tables. The read snapshot ends before deletion.
concurrency_guard_review.guard: Every <=256 candidate batch checks primary-connection data_version and total_changes()+count(Room invalidated=1) inside the short Room writer transaction. A mismatch returns deferred before issuing DELETEs.
concurrency_guard_review.own_changes: After own DELETEs, expected guard is read on that same writer transaction before commit; Room2.8.5 invalidation reset is offset by pending-row count. No guessed data_version increment.
concurrency_guard_review.external_changes: Same-Room author changes and other-connection commits have independent guard components; adding a new root after a batch is conservatively detected before the next candidate DELETE.
concurrency_guard_review.fail_closed: Missing Room guard log or malformed historical roots abort; no assumed zero guard. Cancellation rolls the active batch back, preserving earlier committed batches.
tested_here: one root/stat pass with seven committed batches and actual observer refresh
same/other Room adds root300 between committed batches
same/other Room requests author transaction while actual256 DELETEs are pending commit, then first collector defers and fresh collector retains new root
concurrency_guard_review.raw_limit: Natural phase logs contain no guard-vector samples or writer-entry/commit timestamps. They establish zero first-pass deletion and deferred outcome, not a decomposition of SQL wait/commit time.

remaining_substantive_issues.issue: Neither connection mode has any save interval covering actual deletion (0/30 each), below unchanged20. Actual deletion-contention latency remains unmeasured.
A single rename following after-scan and zero explicit roots do not characterize high-root-cardinality scans, continuous edits, sustained reclamation under commits or long-run fairness.
All nine frozen HistoryCollection correctness cases passed with their original assertions and limits; this is scoped evidence, not proof of all possible database histories.
